Game Overview

The Difference puts players into a memory experience centered on quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Playing The Difference comes down to a simple loop. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is The Difference?

The Difference is a free memory game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is The Difference free to play?

Yes, The Difference is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
